trusted_sections: Work Package PX0-04 - Workbench Shell + Panel Registry
Task 9: Add stable workspace, slot, registry, and UI-session contracts
Task 10: Split renderer from controller and add the six-workspace shell

trusted_statements.objective: Establish the stable six-workspace Debug UI shell, panel contribution registry, UI-local session state, controller orchestration boundary, and renderer split without migrating the full existing capability inventory or entering PX0-05/06 behavior.
trusted_statements.workspace_rule: Exactly these six top-level workspaces exist. PX0-04 must not add a seventh workspace.

registry_contract.panel_context: DebugPanelContext contains only const DebugSnapshot&, DebugControlRouter&, and DebugUiSessionState&.
add_rules: Reject a PanelSlot that does not belong to the declared workspace.
A null visible callback means visible.
Multiple contributions in one valid slot are allowed.
registry_contract.ordering: Within one workspace, contributions are returned in deterministic PanelSlot enum order, then ascending contribution.order, with stable insertion order for ties.
registry_contract.registration: Registration is explicit at composition time. Static-global registration, reflection and dynamic plugin discovery are forbidden.

minimum_state: frame-local control-submission marker used only for presentation refresh
ui_session_contract.invariant: Changing DebugUiSessionState must not mutate Runtime state, Document generation, history, owner queues, or canonical operations.

layout: left sidebar with exactly six workspaces
active-workspace content region sourced from PanelRegistry
footer with latest bounded Debug Control Plane activity
workbench_contract.geometry: Common Workbench code uses available ImGui display geometry with common minimum/preferred sizing rules; it must not retain 410x560 as the semantic layout contract.
workbench_contract.empty_workspace: A workspace with no registered contributions renders an explicit empty/not-yet-migrated engineering state, not a crash or hidden workspace.

transitional_compatibility.reason: PX0-04 establishes the shell before PX0-05 migrates the full capability inventory.
transitional_compatibility.rule: Current Windows/Web callers may keep the existing common buildImGuiPanels entrypoint until PX0-06. That entrypoint must render the new common Workbench shell, not the old top-level fixed tab window.
transitional_compatibility.legacy_controls: Preserve the current Selection, Undo/Redo, Brush/Eraser, Surface and diagnostic controls as one explicitly transitional legacy compatibility contribution under Control/Tools. It may keep its internal legacy tab grouping temporarily, but it is not a new stable slot and must not invent new controls.
transitional_compatibility.selected_tool: The compatibility renderer should derive resolved tool presentation from DebugSnapshot product state. The old selectedTool parameter may remain source-compatible but is not Runtime truth.
transitional_compatibility.persistence: The compatibility entrypoint may hydrate/persist selected workspace through the current ImGui context storage for this temporary host path; it must not use a process-global/static registry or process-global session singleton.
transitional_compatibility.future: PX0-05 replaces the compatibility contribution with final Dashboard/Control/Inspect/Runtime/Performance built-in panel contributions. PX0-06 replaces the compatibility host entrypoint with common DebugController composition.

frame_order: store/publish the one immutable snapshot identity
controller_contract.single_capture_rule: Receipt refresh must not re-query Runtime/Axiom/Arc/Platform/Telemetry providers or manufacture a second coherence identity in the same controller frame.
controller_contract.integration_boundary: PX0-04 implements and tests the controller orchestration object, but Windows/Web host ownership is not thinned to the controller until PX0-06.

renderer_contract.move: ImGuiSkiaRenderer moves out of controller.hpp/controller.cpp into imgui_skia_renderer.hpp/imgui_skia_renderer.cpp.

legacy_abstraction_reconciliation.panels_hpp: Delete the old panels.hpp PanelCapability taxonomy.
legacy_abstraction_reconciliation.debug_panel_enum: Remove the old DebugPanel/PanelState taxonomy from controller.hpp.
legacy_abstraction_reconciliation.panel_model: DebugPanelModel must not remain as a parallel panel taxonomy. It may remain only as a temporary compatibility helper for canSubmitProductControl if needed by an existing regression target; describe()/old enum mapping must be removed.

preserved_boundaries: PX0-02 structured DebugSnapshot and common assembler
PX0-03 DebugControlRouter and bounded activity behavior
Current Windows/Web host presentation/input ownership until PX0-06
Current product and engineering owner semantics

forbidden_interpretations: PX0-04 does not migrate the complete capability inventory into final workspace panels; that is PX0-05.
PX0-04 does not add Scenario runner semantics; PX0-05 Task 12 owns the bounded unsupported scenario entries.
PX0-04 does not thin Windows/Web hosts or move their composition root to DebugController; that is PX0-06.
PX0-04 does not add Shape, RichText editing, Connector, Snap or Image product behavior.
PX0-04 does not add ImGui docking, dynamic plugins, static registration, a RuntimeScene tree browser, raw Document editing, an Operation timeline or a GPU profiler.
PX0-04 does not change RuntimeFacade, owner queue semantics, stable Runtime C ABI, Preview, physical qualification or Gate status.
